content:
🎓✨ A chapter comes to a beautiful close.

Grateful to have celebrated my LL.M. convocation at National Law University, Delhi — a moment filled with pride, gratitude, and a thousand emotions.

Above all, I thank God for His blessings, for giving me strength through every challenge, and for guiding me throughout this journey. 🙏🏻

To my Mom — this achievement belongs to you too. ❤️ Thank you for being my constant strength, for believing in me through every uncertainty, and for standing by me through every high and low. Your love, sacrifices, and prayers have brought me this far, and I can never thank you enough.

And to everyone who played a part in this journey, in ways big or small — thank you. Every experience, every lesson, and every person I encountered has shaped me in ways I will carry forward.

What once felt like a distant dream is now a cherished memory. I leave this chapter grateful for how far I have come, proud of what I have achieved, and hopeful for all that is yet to come. ✨

LL.M. — a journey I will always hold close to my heart. 🎓🤍
